response.rationale: C1 and R4 share the same decisive blasts and trilineage dysplasia; C1 explicitly includes trilineage dysplasia in the label, making it more complete. R5 and R3 only capture secondary hemophagocytosis, and R1 is excluded by 26% blasts.

rejected.why: Only erythrophagocytosis and atypical cells, lacks the 26% blasts that define AML.
Hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis is a secondary syndrome; the underlying AML with 26% blasts is the primary diagnosis.
Trilineage dysplasia alone is insufficient; 26% blasts exceed MDS threshold and indicate AML.
